taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-07, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 2831.4 | 17.20 | 17.20
2 | 3567.9 | 2.07 | 19.27
3 | 3454.3 | 21.64 | 40.91
4 | 11701.4 | 4.12 | 45.03
5 | 140416.4 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve type for station T-07, we examine the resistivity values of the five layers:
- Layer 1: 2831.4 ohm-m
- Layer 2: 3567.9 ohm-m
- Layer 3: 3454.3 ohm-m
- Layer 4: 11701.4 ohm-m
- Layer 5: 140416.4 ohm-m

Next, we evaluate each group of three consecutive layers according to the specified notation:
1.  **Layers 1-2-3:** 2831.4 < 3567.9 > 3454.3 (r1 < r2 > r3), which corresponds to the letter **K**.
2.  **Layers 2-3-4:** 3567.9 > 3454.3 < 11701.4 (r2 > r3 < r4), which corresponds to the letter **H**.
3.  **Layers 3-4-5:** 3454.3 < 11701.4 < 140416.4 (r3 < r4 < r5), which corresponds to the letter **A**.

Combining these letters in order gives the curve type KHA.

{"curve_type": "KHA"}
